text: Prefer choices that can be reversed cheaply when uncertainty is high.
Protect against asymmetric downside before chasing upside.
Assess second-order and feedback-loop effects before final commitment.
Account for structural constraints and institutional barriers to execution.
Evaluate the value of acting now versus waiting for better information.
Preserve strategic optionality when the environment is unstable.
Estimate what additional signal would materially change the decision.
